Plate lab

Every hand-authored plate in the collection, at three sizes, in the current season (autumn), with the alt text each is given and the reference each was traced from. 4 plates, 252 paths between them.

Lucanus cervus

European stag beetle. Coleoptera, Lucanidae. male, dorsal.

validatePlate: clean — 79 paths, no errors

Dorsal view of a male European stag beetle, dark brown, with large antler-like mandibles and lamellate antennae.

Coccinella septempunctata

Seven-spot ladybird. Coleoptera, Coccinellidae. unsexed, dorsal.

validatePlate: clean — 45 paths, no errors

Dorsal view of a Seven-spot ladybird, red, with seven black spots on red wing cases and club-tipped antennae, spotted.

Papilio machaon

Old World swallowtail. Lepidoptera, Papilionidae. unsexed, dorsal.

validatePlate: clean — 51 paths, no errors

Dorsal view of an Old World swallowtail, yellow, with tailed hindwings with a blue band and one orange eyespot and club-tipped antennae, banded across the wings.

Aeshna cyanea

Southern hawker. Odonata, Aeshnidae. male, dorsal.

validatePlate: clean — 77 paths, no errors

Dorsal view of a male Southern hawker, dark brown, with four clear net-veined wings and a long spotted abdomen and tapering antennae, spotted.

The references

Served from references/ rather than public/, so they are never bundled. Vite serves them from the project root at dev time and the build never sees them, because the build never sees this route.
